claim: A fresh SHA-verified join of original globalgamemanagers ResourceManager name/PPtr bytes and original resources.assets metadata ObjectInfo bytes establishes exactly 35,365 original named 'partstex/' source references to fileID5, representing 17,686 distinct resource names. All source numeric PathIDs match original ObjectInfo rows; the matching source ClassIDs are exactly 17,686 Texture2D (28) and 17,679 Sprite (213), paired one of each for 17,679 names. Seven original p2_body highlight names have Texture2D records only in this original resource table. Eleven source folders and their exact class counts are SHA-pinned. This refines already proven FACT-0344 numeric 43,930-fileID5 joins with actual source names/ClassIDs; it does not claim image pixel data, internal Sprite geometry, successful Unity resource loads or rendered results.
